Recovery across declared longitudinal sampling designs. The synthetic K=1 assessment
experiment. Red filled circles denote supported cells, open circles denote unsupported cells,
and grey squares denote cells with incomplete or non-evaluable execution. The dashed red line
marks the predeclared 0.90 recovery-probability gate. The analysis unit is one independently
collected synthetic animal or one repeatedly observed synthetic mouse; the design is
Independent designs resample one destructively collected animal; repeated designs resample
complete subject trajectories. SVD used 2 components and no metadata during decomposition.
Vertical intervals are Wilson 95% confidence intervals for recovery among all 100 requested
replicates per complete cell. Support requires recovery of at least 0.9 , a Wilson lower bound
of at least 0.8 , and complete evaluability. Claim status is implementation proof only ;
results apply only to the displayed synthetic designs and are not a universal sample-size rule.
